name: scikit-learn
purpose: Classic machine learning methods, data splitting and evaluation metrics. Useful for baselines even in deep learning work.
version_guidance: Install the latest release. scikit-learn 1.7 and later need Python 3.10 or newer.

windows.text: Open a terminal in your project folder and activate your virtual environment first.

macos.text: Open a terminal in your project folder and activate your virtual environment first.

linux.text: Open a terminal in your project folder and activate your virtual environment first.

windows.expected: One line: scikit-learn and its version, for example scikit-learn 1.x.y. ModuleNotFoundError means it is not installed in the active environment.

macos.expected: One line: scikit-learn and its version, for example scikit-learn 1.x.y. ModuleNotFoundError means it is not installed in the active environment.

linux.expected: One line: scikit-learn and its version, for example scikit-learn 1.x.y. ModuleNotFoundError means it is not installed in the active environment.

common_problems.solution: Your virtual environment is probably not active, or the package went into another Python. Activate the environment, then install again with python -m pip install.

common_problems.problem: Windows: OSError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory during install
common_problems.solution: The install path is too long for Windows. The official guide explains how to enable long paths. Ask your supervisor or IT before changing the registry.

manual_review: Verification command prints a label before the version so the check is specific to this package. It uses the package's standard __version__ attribute and is not quoted from the official page.
